curated.instructions: omr/instructions/42112-1-1.pdf and 42112-1-2.pdf (two books, 124 and 92 pages; the truck is steps 1-326, ending on book 2 page 86, and book 2 pages 88-89 show the functions)

functions.does: The black 12 tooth gear on top of the cab steers the front two axles (hand of God steering): its upright shaft runs down behind the cab to a shaft along the chassis that works the steering links of both front axles, the first axle turning further than the second.
functions.source: book: book 2 page 88 top-left inset (arrow on the roof gear, arrows at both front axles' wheels)

functions.does: The eight wheels roll. The four rear wheels drive through a differential on each rear axle; the front wheels roll freely on their steering knuckles.
functions.source: book: book 1 (rear axles with their differentials), book 2 page 89 top inset (arrow along the ground)

functions.does: Rolling the truck turns the small engine under the cab: the rear differentials drive a shaft running forward under the chassis, whose 16 tooth gear at the front drives an idler and then a camshaft that pumps four pistons up and down.
functions.source: inferred: the model's drive shaft (p15-p160) runs from the rear axles' bevel gears to the front, where gears drive a shaft of liftarm cams (p133-p139) under four upright axles (p170-p181); the book's function pages don't show it
functions.note: inferred: whether the four upright axles are an engine's pistons; turn both rear wheels the same way, or the differentials take up the drive

functions.does: The white selector lever under the chassis picks how the drum is turned: in one position rolling the truck turns the drum, in the middle (N) nothing does, and in the other the crank on the chassis side turns it. It slides a driving ring along the drum drive shaft between two clutch gears, one driven from the drive shaft, the other from the crank.
functions.source: book: book 2 page 89 insets (the lever with its N label pushed right while the truck rolls, and left while the side crank turns)
functions.note: inferred: the lever's parts and which position is which; slide the ring to engage before the next two functions

functions.does: With the selector set for driving, rolling the truck turns the drum to mix: the drive shaft's 16 tooth gear turns the 20 tooth clutch gear on the drum drive shaft, which runs back to a 24 tooth gear, a shaft through the drum's support, and a universal joint to a 36 tooth gear that turns the drum on the turntable at its front end.
functions.source: book: book 2 page 89 top inset (arrow along the ground, the drum turning)
functions.note: needs the selector lever moved to the driving side first; how far isn't known, so there's no `first` yet

functions.does: With the selector set for the crank, the crank on the side of the chassis turns the drum the other way, to pour: its 12 tooth gear drives a bevel gear on a short shaft whose 16 tooth gear turns the 16 tooth clutch gear on the drum drive shaft.
functions.source: book: book 2 page 89 bottom inset (arrow on the crank, the drum turning, concrete pouring)
functions.note: needs the selector lever moved to the crank side first

functions.does: The drum's back end rides on four small wheels on a rocking frame.
functions.source: book: book 2 page 88 (the rollers under the drum's back end)
functions.note: inferred: the frame rocks so all four rollers stay on the drum

functions.does: The chute at the back swings down from its stowed position for pouring.
functions.source: book: book 2 page 88 bottom-left insets (stowed, and swung down with an arrow)
functions.note: inferred: which parts make the chute (p555-p560, swinging on p519/p527); the hinge chain under it (bodies of p508-p528) may also let it swivel

questions.question: Which way does each lever go for which function? The `first` amounts in this file are guesses.
